title: qutip-trap Device
description: The device record of PLAN.md Section 3.3 as Device.to_dict() writes it (schema version 1).

Crystal.description: The ion crystal (Sections 4.1.2, 4.1.3, 4.1.7): the species of every ion, the equilibrium positions (m, laboratory

Species.description: Immutable atomic data for one isotope (Appendix E).

Level.description: One fine-structure level (Appendix E). ``energy_hz`` is measured from the ground level.

Mode.description: One normal mode of the crystal (Section 4.1.3): its family and position within it (ascending frequency), its frequency

additionalProperties.description: callables have no JSON form; only None is written

Trap.description: Either explicit secular frequencies or voltages plus geometry (Section 3.3).

RfDrive.description: The rf drive of a Paul trap.

Electrodes.description: Electrode geometry; ``parameters`` are the named lengths of the layout in metres (and, for surface kinds,

AnharmonicTerms.description: Coupling coefficients of the optional H_anh and H_curv terms of Section 5.7, in rad/s.

Field.description: The static magnetic field at the ions: quantization axis (Section 4.5.3) and noise (Section 6.3).

NoiseSpectrum.description: ALWAYS two-sided, angular frequency, exp(-i omega t) kernel (Section 13).

Beam.description: One laser beam at the ions (Sections 3.3, 4.2.4): vacuum wavelength (m), unit propagation direction, laboratory-frame

PolarizationModulation.description: AOM, PEM or EOM polarization modulation for dark-state destabilization (Section 8.1).

NoiseModel.description: The noise of a device as spectra, drifts and event rates, never as phenomenological error rates (Sections 4.1.5, 6.1 to

Mains.description: Mains pickup: amplitude per harmonic and the line-trigger policy (Section 6.3).

Drift.description: A slow parameter: rms amplitude, correlation time, optional servo bandwidth, optional ramp (Section 7.5).

Collisions.description: Background-gas collisions as instantaneous events with an outcome distribution (Section 6.7).

Detector.description: The photon detector of the device (Sections 8.2, 8.5, 8.8): its kind, the total system detection efficiency, the

HardwareChain.description: DDS/AOM/amplifier response: quantization, rise time, bandwidth, dead time, phase continuity (Section 7.10).

Zone.description: One named trapping site or junction leg of a multi-zone array.

PreparationRecipe.description: How the device cools and pumps before every shot (Section 4.2.6 order: Doppler -> sideband -> pump).

SidebandCoolingSpec.description: A pulsed Raman sideband-cooling stage (Section 4.2.2, Che 2017 / Rasmusson 2021 schedules) on the Raman pair.

GradientField.description: The near-field microwave-gradient drive's field configuration (PLAN.md Section 4.4.5; Srinivas et al. 2021).

BeamRoles.description: Which of a device's beams play which part (Section 7.3; docs/api_proposal.md Section 4.6; 0.2.0): per ion the drive

GateDrive.description: How gates on one ion are driven: the drive kind and the beams that implement it (Section 7.3); for a light-shift

LightShiftCouplings.description: The level structure of a light-shift (sigma_z sigma_z) drive relative to its force amplitude (Section 4.4.4).
